_doc: Catalog of every allowed map object type (AD-28). scripts/check-map.mjs validates each map in data/maps/ against it. Positions are tile coordinates. shape: point (x,y), rect (x,y,w,h) or path (points). inWall: false = objects must stand on walkable tiles, true = may overlap solid tiles (facades, ramps), 'perch' = may sit on a fence tile when the object has perch:true. reach: must be walkable-reachable from the map's first entry or spawn. Field types: string, int, number, bool, enum (values), color (#rrggbb), i18n (key in i18n/*.json), mapId, ids (array of object ids), points (array of [x, y]).

debug.doc: only present in debug sessions (?debug, ?bench), skipped in gameplay

auto.doc: true: enter on touch, otherwise walk in and press interact

street.doc: An unattended identifiable street ride; object-scoped temporary use, not ownership.

toast.doc: HUD toast key shown when a player enters the zone

toastLeave.doc: HUD toast key shown when a player leaves the zone

r.doc: radius in px of the area the stick can whack

hp.doc: whacks it takes to drop its loot (once per game day, later whacks only shake it)

loot.doc: id of a loot table in data/stick-world.json (bush.tables); one drop per bush per game day (flag bush-<id>-day)

bush.doc: a walk-through bush the stick shakes; drawn procedurally (entities/Bushes.js)

side.doc: where the house wall is: up = north of the bell, down = south of it. The door stands on the next tile to the right and the neighbor steps out there

doorbell.doc: swing the stick at it or press interact next to it: Ding-Dong, then a harmless ding-dong-run (entities/Doorbells.js)

hp.doc: whacks until it bursts; one burst per game day

pinata.doc: a pinata hung in a party frame (entities/Pinata.js draws the frame, bunting and table around it)

balloon.doc: a kirmes balloon the slingshot pops (PROP sensor body, respawns; entities/Balloons.js)

fair-stall.doc: the kirmes stall (art only) the balloons are tied to; x is its centre tile, y its front tile

points.doc: continuous tile coordinates, [x.5, y.5] is a tile centre; a skater grinds along the polyline

width.doc: rail thickness in tiles; the catch zone is this plus data/tricks.json grind.capture

dir.doc: the direction a skater rides up it and is launched

height.doc: launch height in px; more height, more airtime

dir.doc: the direction that goes down the stairs

bench.doc: its centre line along the long side is a grindable edge (data/tricks.json bench)

manual-pad.doc: a marked flat strip for manuals (art and the skatepark line check only)

r.doc: radius in tiles around the tile centre: rolling through it slowly with a chain banks it cleanly with a bonus (data/tricks.json bankSpot)

points.doc: continuous tile coordinates of the designed route (arrows in ?debug)

steps.doc: ids of the trick objects the line chains, in order

role.doc: building: the facade of the dojo in the town (art over wall tiles, entities/Dojo.js); sensei: the 1x1 spot where the master stands (interact starts the training); mats: the training area (edges and emblem); rack: the belt rack on the north wall

dojo.doc: the karate dojo (story 6.4): its building outside, its master, mats and belt rack inside

chore-board.doc: the chore board at home: interact lists the chores of data/activities.json (entities/Activities.js, ui/screens/ChoreScreen.js)

lookout.doc: a bully with a phone who spots players inside data/chase.json lookout.radius and calls the gang (entities/Lookouts.js)

critter.doc: a pigeon, a cat on a fence or a duck on the pond (data/critters.json, entities/Critters.js); only a picture, never hittable

newsstand.doc: the newspaper stand where the newspaper route starts (data/activities.json route, entities/Activities.js)

bike-rack.doc: a bike let go of within data/theft.json rackRadius is chained here (locked, safe from borrowing)

bike-hideout.doc: where a bully hides a borrowed bike; the family fetches it back from here (entities/BikeTheft.js)

vehicle.doc: id of the vehicle found behind the door on the first interact (a data/vehicles.json profile)

hiddenFlag.doc: key in state.shared.flags that is set once the garage has been opened

garage.doc: a garage door; its rect is drawn as the door and is where the interact press counts (entities/Garage.js)

board.doc: the short word painted on the signpost board (default LINES, the skatepark hint)
